 1                   I.      INTRODUCTION AND QUALIFICATIONS

 2   Q1.   PLEASE STATE YOUR NAME, BUSINESS ADDRESS.

 3   A.    My name is Omar A. Gallegos. My business address is 100 North Stanton Street,

 4         El Paso, Texas, 79901.

 5

 6   Q2.   ON WHOSE BEHALF ARE YOU SUBMITTING THIS TESTIMONY

 7   A.    I am filing this testimony on behalf of El Paso Electric Company ("EPE" or the

 8         "Company").

 9

10   Q3.   HAVE YOU PREVIOUSLY SUBMITTED TESTIMONY IN THIS

11         PROCEEDING?

12   A.    Yes. I submitted Direct Testimony in this proceeding on March 27, 2026.

13

18         Bench Request Paragraph 9.i.

 3   Q5.   WHAT HAS THE COMMISSION REQUESTED IN PARAGRAPH 9.i OF

 4         THE PRE-HEARING BENCH REQUEST?

 5   A.    Paragraph 9.i of the Pre-Hearing Bench Request requests “[a] loads and resources

 6         table showing both current loads and resources and the projected loads and

 7         resources once projects currently approved and under construction are brought into

 8         service.”

 9

10   Q6.   IN RESPONSE TO PARAGRAPH 9.i., PROVIDE A LOADS AND

11         RESOURCES TABLE SHOWING BOTH CURRENT LOADS AND

12         RESOURCES AND THE PROJECTED LOADS AND RESOURCES ONCE

13         PROJECTS CURRENTLY APPROVED AND UNDER CONSTRUCTION

14         ARE BROUGH INTO SERVICE.

15   A.    Please see Exhibit OAG-1S for EPE’s Updated 2025 New Mexico L&R. The table

16         includes the Commission approved Carne Project (130 MW solar and 65 MW

17         battery energy storage system ("BESS")) which achieved COD on April 21, 2026.

18         The table also includes the full 150 MW solar and 50 MW BESS component of the

19         Santa Teresa Project which was approved for New Mexico in Case No. 25-00038-

20         UT i. and is expected to be in service by June 2026. The table does not include

  DECLARATION OF OMAR A. GALLEGOS IN SUPPORT OF THE FOREGOING
 SUPPLEMENTAL DIRECT TESTIMONY TO THE COMMISSION’S APRIL 23, 2026
                  PRE-HEARING BENCH REQUEST

       I, Omar A. Gallegos, pursuant to Rule 1-011 NMRA, state as follows:

       1.      I affirm in writing under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of

New Mexico that the following statements are true and correct.

       2.      I am over 18 years of age and have personal knowledge of the facts stated herein.

I am employed by El Paso Electric Company ("EPE" or “the Company”) as the Vice President of

Energy Delivery.

       3.      The foregoing Supplemental Direct Testimony of Omar A. Gallegos, together with

all exhibits sponsored therein and attached thereto, is true and accurate based on my knowledge

and belief.

       4.      I submit this Declaration, based upon my personal knowledge and upon information

and belief, in support of EPE’s Application for Revisions of Its Retail Electric Rates Pursuant to

Advice Notice No. 317.




                                                1
 FURTHER, DECLARANT SAYETH NAUGHT.


I declare under penalty of perjury that the foregoing is true and correct.

Executed on May 7, 2026.
